curated_items.title: Creating AI value with enterprise context
curated_items.summary: Across a business, any number of AI platforms, systems, and tools may be at work simultaneously—for example, AI-powered customer platforms, conversational assistants, and workflow and process automation tools. Each one is sophisticated, advanced, and quick to respond. But, when set to work, the outcomes and actions that emerge may be wrong, confused, or lacking a proper understanding of the business. Many organizations find themselves in this situation—and it could be one of key reasons they struggle to extract returns on their AI investments. curated_items.summary: If you want to compete, you need to be multi-model. And if you want to take advantage of everything that different AI models have to offer, you need a great harness. And then you have to maintain it, which is even harder. Luckily, the GitHub engineering team built a best-in-class, truly multi-model harness , which we’ve adopted company-wide.
